senses.gloss: vigrahadramma-visovaka (EI 1), name of a coin; the latter part of the name (i. e. visovaka = viṃśopaka) suggests that it was one-twentieth of the vigraha-dramma in value.
vigrahapāla-dramma (EI 1), name of a coin; same as vigrahapāla-satka-dramma, vigrahapālīya-dramma.
vigrahapāla-dramma , ‘dramma issued or minted by Vigrahapāla’; same as vigraha-dramma (q. v.), etc.; see dramma.
vigrahapāla-satka-dramma , same as vigrahapāla-dramma (q. v.), etc.; see dramma.
vigrahapālīya-dramma (EI 1; CII 4), name of a coin apparently so called after a king named Vigrahapāla.
vigrahapālīya-dramma , ‘dramma issued or minted by Vigrahapāla’; same as vigraha-dramma (q. v.), etc.
vigrahatuṅgīya-dramma (EI 1; CII 4), name of a coin apparently so called after a king named Vigrahatuṅga.
vigrahatuṅgīya-dramma , ‘dramma issued or minted by Vigrahatuṅga’; cf. vigraha-dramma, etc.; see dramma.
vigraha-dramma , ‘dramma issued or minted by Vigraha’; same as vigrahapāla-dramma, etc.; see dramma.
vigraha-dramma-visvovaka , ‘(1/20) of the vigraha-dramma’; see dramma and viṃśopaka.
